name: Torrents of Spring
notes: Wavebreaking Thunder: ATK +16% always. Royal Decree (after the wielder's Electro hit): Stellar-Conduct DMG of the active character +20%. Completed (after an Electro Stellar-Conduct hit): wielder ATK +16% more and active character Stellar-Conduct DMG +20% more.
`param` is the index of the value in the passive's parameters (0: ATK, 2: Stellar-Conduct DMG, 3: extra ATK, 4: extra Stellar-Conduct DMG).
